scope: successor-release review of reviewed polygon render geometry

frontier_displacement.rationale: Measure policy-induced boundary smoothing before canonical-land clipping so coastline replacement does not masquerade as inland/frontier displacement.

raw_to_final_render_hausdorff.rationale: Final canonical-land clipping can dominate whole-geometry Hausdorff distance at coastlines and islands; it must not be compared directly with smoothing-only candidate metrics or used alone as a successor rejection gate.

final_render_change.interpretation: Independent candidate gates; exceedance requires bounded override plus visual review.

topology.rationale: Detailed canonical-land clipping can legitimately split coastal/island components. Review whether the change is coastal/topological rather than historical-frontier movement.

successor_reuse_rules.unchanged_predecessor_render: May be reused after corpus/family review when corrected quantitative axes pass and no new source/policy change is introduced.
successor_reuse_rules.policy_substitution: Requires exact same source geometry, candidate metrics inside gates, temporal-family comparison and visual review.
successor_reuse_rules.bounded_override: Allowed only when a candidate gate is exceeded for a documented cartographic reason, the raw source remains preserved, canonical-land hard gate passes, and visual review confirms no unsupported inland/frontier rewrite.
successor_reuse_rules.point_or_nonpolygon_geometry: Reuse exact reviewed source geometry; polygon envelope does not apply.
successor_reuse_rules.unresolved_geometry: Remain unresolved until independently defensible geometry exists.
